description: Get a file that is not at a public URL into a conversion to "to". Returns a one-time link (1 hour, one file, counts toward the limits like convert) in two forms: (1) upload_page – a web page where the USER picks the file in the browser; use it when the file is on the user's computer and you cannot run commands there (e.g. in a chat app): give the user the link, then call get_job with upload_id (wait_seconds up to 25, repeat while "waiting_for_upload"; a rejected file – wrong format, too large – is reported as last_error and the link stays valid for another file). (2) command – a curl command for when YOU have the file and can run shell commands (e.g. Claude Code): replace FILE with the path and run it; the shell must be able to reach https://www.conved.com (sandboxes often block outgoing connections). It prints the job as JSON. If the connection fails, fall back to data_base64 for a file of tens of kB, or to a public link. Use only one of the two forms – the link works once.

from.description: Source format id, only when it cannot be told from the file name extension – e.g. a URL like download.php?id=5. Otherwise leave it out.

name: create_upload
title: Upload a local file
